verses: Tamam tareefen uss Allah kay liye sazawaar hain jiss ki milkiyat mein woh sab kuch hai jo aasmano aur zamin mein hai aakhirat mein bhi tareef ussi kay liye hai, woh (bari) hikmaton wala aur (poora) khabardaar hai
Jo zamin mein jaye aur jo uss say niklay jo aasman say utray aur jo charh ker uss mein jaye woh sab say ba-khabar hai. Aur woh meharban nihayat bakhsish wala hai

Kuffaar kehtay hain kay hum per qayamat nahi aaye gi. Aap keh dijiye! kay mujhay meray rab ki qasam! jo aalam aalim-ul-ghaib hai kay woh yaqeenan tum per aaye gi Allah Taalaa say aik zarray kay barabar ki cheez bhi posheedah nahi na aasmano mein aur na zamin mein balkay)yeh uss say bhi choti aur bari cheez khulli kitab mein mojood hai
Takay woh eman walon aur kaaron ko bhalaee ata farmaye, yehi log hain jin kay liye maghfirat aur izzat ki rozi hai
Aur humari aayaton ko neecha dikhaney ki jinhon ney koshish ki hai yeh woh log hain jin kay liye bad-tareen qasam ka dard-naak azab hai
Aur jinhen ilm hai woh dekh len gay kay jo kuch aap ki janib aap kay rab ki taraf say nazil hua hai woh (sirasir) haq hai aur Allah ghalib khoobiyon walay ki raah ki rehbari kerta hai
Aur kafiron ney kaha (aao) hum tumhen aik aisa shakhs batlayen jo tumhen yeh khabar phoncha raha hai kay jab tum bilkul hi reza reza hojao gay to tum phir say aik naee pedaeesh mein aao gay

(hum nahi keh saktay) kay khud uss ney (hi) Allah per jhoot bandh liya hai ya ussay deewangi hai balkay)yeh (haqeeqat yeh hai) kay aakhirat per yaqeen na rakhney walay hi azab mein aur door ki gumrahi mein hain

Kiya pus woh apney aagay peechay aasman o zamin ko dekh nahi rahey hain? Agar hum chahayen to unhen zamin mein dhansa den ya unn per aasman kay tukray gira den, yaqeenan uss mein poori daleel hai her uss banday kay liye jo (dil say) mutawajha ho
Aur hum ney Dawood per apna fazal kiya, aey paharo! uss kay sath raghbat say tasbeeh parha kero aur parindon ko bhi (yehi hukum hai) aur hum ney uss kay liye loha naram kerdiya
Kay to poori poori zirhen bana aur joron mein andaza rakh tum sab nek kaam kiya kero. (yaqeen mano) kay mein tumharay aemaal dekh raha hun

Aur hum ney Sulaiman kay liye hua ko musakhar kerdiya kay subha ki manzil uss ki maheeney bhar ki hoti thi aur shaam ki manzil bhi aur hum ney unn kay liye taanbay ka chashma baha diya. Aur uss kay rab kay hukum say baaz jinnat uss ki ma-tehati mein uss kay samney kaam kertay thay aur unn mein say jo bhi humaray hukum say sirtabi keray hum ussay bharakti hui aag kay azab ka maza chakhayen gay

Jo kuch Sulaiman chahatay woh jinnat tayyar ker detay maslan qilay aur mujassmay aur hozon kay barabar lagan aur choolhon per jami hui mazboot deygen, aey aal Dawood uss kay shukriya mein nek amal kero, meray bandon mein say shukar-guzar banday kum hi hotay hain

Phir jab hum ney unn per maut ka hukum bhej diya to unn ki khabar jinnat ko kissi ney na di siwaye ghun kay keeray kay jo unn ki asa ko kha raha tha. Pus jab (Sulaiman) gir paray uss waqt jinno ney jaan liya kay agar woh ghaib daan hotay to uss kay zillat kay azab mein mubtila na rehtay

Qom saba kay liye apni bastiyon mein (qudrat elahi ki) nishani thi unn kay dayen bayen do baagh thay (hum ney unn ko hukum diya tha kay) apney rab ki di hui rozi khao aur uss ka shukar ada kero, yeh umdah shehar aur woh bakhshney wala rab hai

Lekin unhon ney roo-gardani ki to hum ney unn per zor kay selab (ka pani) bhej diya aur hum ney unn kay (haray bharay) baghon kay badlay do (aisay) baagh diye jo bad-maza mewon walay aur (ba-kasrat) jhao aur kuch bairi kay darakhton walay thay
Hum ney unn ki na-shukri ka yeh badla unhen diya. Hum (aisi) sakht saza baray baray na-shukron hi ko detay hain

Aur hum ney unn kay aur unn bastiyon kay darmiyan jin mein hum ney barkat dey rakhi thi chand bastiyan aur (abad) rakhi thin jo sir-e-raah zahir thin, aur unn mein chalney ki manzilen muqarrar kerdi thin unn mein raaton aur dino ko ba aman mein chaltay phirtay raho

Lekin unhon ney phir kaha kay aey humaray perwerdigar! humaray safar door daraz kerdey chunkay khud unhon ney apney hathon apna bura kiya uss liye hum ney unhen (guzishta) fasano ki soorat mein kerdiya aur unn kay tukray tukray ura diye. Bila-shuba her aik sabar-o-shukar kerney walay kay liye uss (maajray) mein boht si ibraten hain
Aur shetan ney unn kay baray mein apna guman sacha ker dikhaya yeh log sab kay sab uss kay tabeydaar bann gaye siwaye mominon ki aik jamat kay

Shetan ka unn per koi zor (aur dabao) na tha magar uss liye kay hum unn logon ko jo aakhirat per eman rakhtay hain zahir ker den unn logon mein say jo uss say shak mein hain. Aur aap ka rab (her) her cheez per nigehbaan hai

Keh dijiye! kay Allah kay siwa jin jin ka tumhen guman hai (sab) ko pukar lo, na unn mein say kissi ko aasmano aur zaminon mein say aik zarra ka ikhtiyar hai na unn ka unn mein koi hissa hai na unn mein say koi Allah ka madadgar hai

Shifaat (sifarish) bhi uss kay pass kuch nafa nahi deti ba-juz unn kay jin kay liye ijazat hojaye. Yahan tak kay jab unn kay dilon say ghabrahat door kerdi jati hai to poochtay hain tumharay perwerdigar ney kiya farmaya? Jawab detay hain kay haq farmaya aur woh buland bala aur boht bara hai
Poochiye kay tumhen aasmano aur zamin say rozi kaun phonchata hai? (khud) jawab dijiye! kay Allah Taalaa. (suno) hum ya tum. Ya to yaqeenan hidayat per hain ya khulli gumrahi mein hain?
Keh dijiye! kay humaray kiye huye gunahon ki babat tum say koi sawal na kiya jaye ga na tumharay aemaal ki purs hum say ki jaye gi
Unhen khabar dey dijiye kay hum sab ko humara rab jama kerkay phir hum mein sachay faislay kerdey ga. Woh faislay chukaney wala hai aur dana
Keh dijiye! kay acha mujhay bhi to unhen dikha do jinhen tum Allah ka shareek thehra ker uss kay sath mila rahey ho, aisa hergiz nahi, balkay)yeh o hi Allah hai ghalib ba-hikmat
Hum ney aap ko tamam logon kay liye khushkhabriyan sunaney wala aur daraney wala bana ker bheja hai haan magar (yeh sahih hai) kay logon ki aksariyat be-ilm hai
Poochtay hain kay woh wada hai kab? Sachay ho to bata do
Jawab dijiye kay waday ka din theek moyyen hai jiss say aik sa’at na tum peechay hatt saktay ho na aagay barh saktay ho

Aur kafiron ney kaha kay hum hergiz na to uss Quran ko manen na uss say pehlay ki kitabon ko! aey dekhney walay kaash kay to unn zalimon ko uss waqt dekhta jab kay yeh apney rab kay samney kharay huye aik doosray ko ilzam dey rahey hun gay kamzor log baray logon say kahen gay agar tum na hotay to hum to momin hotay
Yeh baray log unn kamzoron ko jawab den gay kay kiya tumharay pass hidayat chukney kay baad hum ney tumhen uss say roka tha? (nahi) balkay)yeh tum (khud) hi mujrim thay

(uss kay jawab mein) yeh kamzor log unn mutakabbiron say kahen gay, (nahi nahi) balkay)yeh din raat makar-o-faraib say humen Allah kay sath kufur kerney aur uss kay shareek muqarrar kerney ka tumhara hukum dena humari emaani ka baees hua, aur azab ko dekhtay hi sab kay sab dil mein pashemaan ho rahey hun gay, aur kafiron ki gardano mein hum toq daal den gay unhen sirf unn kay kiye keraye aemaal ka badla diya jaye ga
Aur hum to jiss basti mein jo bhi aagah kerney wala bheja o haan kay khushal logon ney yehi kaha kay jiss cheez kay sath tum bhejay gaye ho hum uss kay sath kufur kerney walay hain
Aur kaha hum maal o aulad mein boht barhay huye hain yeh nahi hosakta kay hum azab diye jayen
Keh dijiye! kay mera rab jiss kay liye chahaye rozi kushadah ker deta hai aur tang bhi ker deta hai, lekin aksar log nahi jantay

Aur tumharay maal aur aulad aisay nahi kay tumhen humaray pass (martabon say) qareeb ker den haan jo eman layen aur nek amal keren unn kay liye unn kay aemaal ka dohra ajar hai aur woh nidar o khof ho ker bala khano mein rahen gay
Aur jo log humari aayaton kay muqablay ki tag-o-do o do mein lagay rehtay hain yehi hain jo azab mein pakar ker hazir rakhay jayen gay

Keh dijiye! kay mera rab apney bandon mein jiss kay liye chahaye rozi kushadah kerta hai aur jiss kay liye chahaye tang ker deta hai, tum jo kuch bhi Allah ki raah mein kharach kero gay Allah uss ka (poora poora) badla dey ga aur woh sab say behtar rozi denay wala hai
Aur unn sab ko Allah uss din jama kerkay farishton say daryaft farmaye ga kay kiya yeh log tumhari ibadat kertay thay
Woh kahen gay teri zaat pak hai aur humara o li to to hai na kay yeh balkay)yeh yeh log jinno ki ibadat kertay thay, unn mein kay aksar ka unn hi per eman tha
Pus aaj tum mein say koi (bhi) kissi kay liye (bhi kissi qasam kay) nafa nuksan ka malik na hoga. Aur hum zalimon say keh den gay kay uss aag ka azab chakho jissay tum jhutlatay rahey

Aur jab unn kay samney humari saaf saaf aayaten parhi jati hain to kehtay hain kay yeh aisa shakhs hai jo tumhen tumharay baap dada kay maboodon say rok dena chahata hai. (uss kay siwa koi baat nahi), aur kehtay hain kay yeh to ghara hua jhoot hai aur haq unn kay pass chuka phir bhi kafir yehi kehtay rahey kay yeh to khulla hua jadoo hai
Aur unn (Makkah walon) ko na to hum ney kitaben dey rakhi hain jinhen yeh parhtay hun na unn kay pass aap say pehlay koi aagah kerney wala aaya

Aur unn say pehlay kay logon ney bhi humari baaton ko jhutlaya tha aur unhen hum ney jo dey rakha tha yeh to uss kay daswen hissay ko bhi nahi phonchay, pus unhon ney meray rasoolon ko jhutlaya, (phir dekh kay) mera azab kaisa (sakht) tha

Keh dijiye! kay mein tumhen sirf aik hi baat ki naseehat kerta hun kay tum Allah kay wastay (zidd chor ker) do do mill ker ya tanha tanha kharay ho ker socho to sahi, tumharay uss rafiq ko koi junoon nahi, woh to tumhen aik baray (sakht) azab kay aaney say pehlay daraney wala hai
Keh dijiye! kay jo badla mein tum say maangoon woh tumharay liye hai mera badla to Allah Taalaa hi kay zimmay hai. Woh her cheez say ba-khabar (aur mutlaa) hai
Keh dijiye! kay mera rab haq (sachi wahee) nazil farmata hai woh her ghaib ka jannay wala hai
Keh dijiye kay haq chuka baatil na to pehlay kuch ker saka hai aur na kersakay ga

Keh dijiye kay agar mein behak jaon to meray behakney (ka wabaal) mujh per hi hai aur agar mein raah hidayat per hun to ba sabab uss wahee kay jo mera perwerdigar mujhay kerta hai woh bara hi sunnay wala aur boht hi qareeb hai
Aur agar aap (woh waqt) mulahiza keren jab kay yeh kuffaar ghabraye phiren gay phir nikal bhagney ki koi soorat na hogi aur qareeb ki jagah say giriftar ker liye jayen gay
Uss waqt kahen gay kay hum uss Quran per eman laye lekin uss qadar door jagah say (matlooba cheez) kaisay hath sakti hai
Uss say pehlay to unhon ney uss say kufur kiya tha, aur door daraz say bann dekhay hi phenktay rahey
Unn ki chahaton aur unn kay darmiyan pardah haeel kerdiya gaya jaisay kay uss say pehlay bhi unn jaison kay sath kiya gaya, woh bhi (unn hi ki tarah) shak shak-o-taraddud mein (paray huye) thay
